activity_statements.statement: partners with automobile dealers to provide vehicle financing to credit-challenged consumers who would otherwise not qualify for traditional auto loans
originates and services consumer auto loans on behalf of dealer partners, purchasing dealer-assigned contracts and managing collections
offers pre-qualification tools and dealer management software enabling dealers to structure financing deals for subprime borrowers

name_reality_gap: Indexed as 'Financial Services & Insurance' — accurate in sector but misses the very specific niche: Credit Acceptance is a subprime auto lender operating through a dealer channel, not a generalist financial services firm. It is not an insurer.
extraction_notes: About page was clear on business model. Public company with well-documented 10-K; subprime auto lending via dealer channel is the singular business line.
